subject.title: fix(signal): preserve newlines in debounced messages

question: Should this PR require redacted real Signal runtime evidence before merge, or is the focused regression coverage plus final green CI sufficient for this channel-formatting fix?
rationale: Only a maintainer can decide whether the unavailable linked Signal account is required for merge proof; automation cannot manufacture that account-level evidence.

options.title: Require live Signal proof
options.body: Request a redacted send/receive or bridge-log demonstration that a debounced batch reaches agent context with real line breaks before merge.

options.title: Accept focused proof
options.body: Accept the targeted regression assertions and completed exact-head CI as sufficient for this bounded formatting correction.

recommendation.title: Require live Signal proof
